name: Sagyn Padilla-Nti
role: Contract broker and resource coordinator — fixer
location: The Canopy — elevated walkway district above Geartown, near Lincoln and Addison
description:
Sagyn Padilla-Nti are average height but with a presence that fills more space than the body accounts for. At 37, their face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — internal drug synthesizer — produces combat stims and medical compounds on deman — and they make no effort to hide it.

They taught themself the trade through trial, error, and a pain tolerance that concerns the people who know them best. They work as a fixer out of The Canopy, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

Sagyn Padilla-Nti are the kind of runner other runners tell stories about, though the stories vary depending on who they burned last.

core_fears: Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
core_desires: Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
Freedom from augmentation debt — the interest compounds like a tumor
coping_mechanisms: Humor — deflects everything serious with jokes until the joke becomes the personality
Substances — stims to stay sharp, downers to sleep, a careful pharmaceutical tightrope
Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
blind_spots: Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Assumes the worst in corporate people, missing the rare ones who could be allies
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
psychology.secret: Sagyn Padilla-Nti killed someone who didn't deserve it on a job three years ago and has never told anyone. The face appears in dreams weekly.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Flat affect, monotone delivery. The content is terrifying but the voice never rises.
speech_patterns.cadence: Low and even — the vocal equivalent of still water.
verbal_tics: Pauses mid-sentence to listen — combat habit that bleeds into conversation
Swears in three languages, often in the same sentence
example_lines: "I know a person who knows a person. That's not evasion — that's the service."
"My commission is fifteen percent. You're welcome to find someone cheaper. You won't find someone better."
"The job isn't dangerous. The people involved are dangerous. The job is just logistics."

story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive offers Sagyn Padilla-Nti a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
A crew member from Sagyn Padilla-Nti's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
A dead drop Sagyn Padilla-Nti maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
narrative_function: Sagyn Padilla-Nti represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. Their stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Internal drug synthesizer — produces combat stims and medical compounds on demand. Neural dampener — blocks external hacking attempts, passive ICE in the brain
daily_life: Irregular schedule dictated by contract timing. Between jobs: equipment maintenance, physical training, and the careful management of a reputation that exists entirely through word of mouth. Drinks at establishments where runners gather — not for pleasure, but for market intelligence.

strengths: photographic memory for faces and layouts
weaknesses: risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities
augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions

decision_rules: Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
habits: Wears the same item of clothing for luck — a scarf, a glove, a specific pair of boots
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
breaking_points: Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity
Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out

physical_description.heritage: Filipino / West African / Eastern European (multilayered diaspora)
physical_description.build: Lean and economical — muscle distributed for function rather than aesthetics. Wiry frame that suggests sustained training and controlled caloric intake. No excess, no softness.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with premature silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back tight, often in a high knot or secured with industrial clips
physical_description.hair_length: Medium — shoulder-length when unbound, kept severe
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with faint amber undertone
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium olive — warm undertones with subtle golden cast
physical_description.complexion: Sharp-featured face with high cheekbones and a narrow jaw. Skin shows the texture of someone who spends time exposed to environmental stress — not weathered, but marked. Minimal grooming affectation; they look like they shave when practical rather than cosmetic.
distinguishing_marks: Surgical scar running 8cm along the left collarbone — clean line, old enough to have faded to pale silver
Burn marks across the knuckles of both hands — small, overlapping, consistent with sustained exposure to heat or chemical contact
Faint lattice of thin white scars on the inside of the right forearm — deliberate, parallel lines spaced 5mm apart, partially obscured by the visible chrome work
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome biosynthesizer visible at the base of the neck and upper chest — metallic silver with faint blue circulation-indicator LEDs that pulse slowly. The chrome is unshielded and intentionally exposed; they wear it like a credential. Neural interface ports visible behind the left ear, marked with a thin scar line in the shape of a crescent.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision — no wasted motion, no performative gesture. They stand slightly asymmetrical, weight favoring the right side. Their gaze is direct and sustained, holding eye contact longer than social convention suggests is comfortable. When still, they radiate coiled readiness rather than relaxation.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical aesthetics with deliberate wear markers. Black synthetic jacket with reinforced shoulders and visible stitching — custom-fitted, nondescript brand. Underneath: gray compression shirt that serves both function and thermoregulation. Cargo pants in matte charcoal with multiple sealed pockets and subtle tool loops. Boots are heavy-soled, modular, the kind that can be repaired or upgraded in the field. No jewelry except a thin steel bracelet on the left wrist — possibly functional, possibly not. Clothing shows signs of regular maintenance but not vanity — everything is serviceable, nothing is new.
